result.title: A Semi-Analytical Inference Framework for Structural Causal Models
result.summary: Structural Causal Models (SCMs) provide a principled framework for observational, interventional, and counterfactual reasoning, all of which rely on probabilistic inference. Existing frameworks either transform SCMs into alternative tractable representations or rely on approximate inference with expressive generative models. We instead perform inference using a message passing scheme directly on the SCM by representing structural mechanisms and probability densities in a common finite-dimensional function space. Forward propagation combines a numerical realization of the Law of the Unconscious Statistician, while propagated densities are recovered by spline projection from LOTUS moments. The same representation naturally yields backward message passing for conditioning, providing a unified framework for causal inference. Using tensor-product B-spline bases, the resulting algorithm expresses inference through numerical quadrature and linear algebra without explicitly constructing conditional distributions. Experiments on randomly generated continuous SCMs demonstrate accurate approximation of Monte Carlo reference solutions and systematic improvement with increasing basis resolution.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一种半解析推断框架：将结构因果模型的结构机制与概率密度表示在同一有限维函数空间中，通过前向传播结合 LOTUS 的数值实现、并由样条投影恢复传播密度，同时在 B 样条基下得到用于条件化的反向消息传递，从而在随机连续 SCM 上以数值积分与线性代数完成因果推断。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属较远的因果推断领域，但其「在共享有限维函数空间中前向传播密度、反向消息传递做条件化」的表述可能与 LVR 中潜在信念状态/假设分布的更新及视觉证据条件化存在概念对应，可供核查是否可借用其状态传播与条件化视角。
